limitations: Implicit selection is model-dependent. The copy-only negative loaded preflight in both trials; both answers remained concise with no general CI recommendations. This failure is retained.
One run per case and one targeted rerun after a metadata correction do not estimate activation reliability or establish causal improvement.
Automated positive activation remains unknown without a successful directly bound staged entrypoint read; independent manual observations are separate.
Model/provider defaults applied; effective model identity was not exposed in the retained event stream.
Read-only offline trials cannot establish enforcement before a live push. No hooks or mandatory ship dispatcher were added.
Configured work is not observed execution, measured timing, billing, or net savings.
The placeholder journey fixture does not validate removal of a real external-service quota guard.
Raw answers, traces, Git workspaces and host metadata remain private outside source and runtime archives.
